title.narrative: TO BUILD A SUSTAINABLE PROCESS FOR ACCOUNTING FOR MISSING PERSONS

description.narrative: In December 2022, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of The Netherlands awarded funding for five years to the International Commission on Missing Persons’ (ICMP) Iraq and Libya programs, of which 20% is allocated for its operations Libya and 80% is allocated for its operations Iraq.

description.narrative: As of submitting this PITT, ICMP plans to work with the Attorney General's Office to identify Libyan institutions who will be involved in rolling out ICMP's Integrated Data Management System (iDMS).

title.narrative: Outcome 2: Standards and procedures applied in investigations concerning missing persons cases and capacities of local institutions are enhanced
Degree to which training participants implement learning acquired from ICMP training initiatives by the project end

description.narrative: ICMP evaluates the extent to which participants apply what they have learned from the training. In the form of a survey or semi-structured interview administered to training participants at least three months after receiving the training, ICMP measures the extent to which the trainees apply the intended learning outcomes from the training in the workplace. This helps ICMP in planning for and improving future training courses.

Number of CSOs engaged to advocate the issue of missing persons

description.narrative: The total number pertains to unique CSOs, but ICMP will endeavor to engage CSOs on a regular basis, i.e. CSOs engaged in year 1 may also be engaged with in the subsequent period/s.

title.narrative: Output 2.1: The capacity of national institutions to excavate suspected mass grave sites and other sites of forensic interest according to international standards is strengthened

description.narrative: ICMP will provide technical/financial/logistical support towards field activities to mass grave sites as conducted by the Libyan authorities. Benualeed will potentially a pilot project.

title.narrative: Percentage of training participants reporting an increase in knowledge and skills to conduct investigations according to international standards

description.narrative: This indicator will measure the level of appreciation and understanding of the training ICMP will conduct for goverment representatives responsible for excavations. Training will include crime scene investigation.

description.narrative: This indicator will track the number of awareness-raising sessions ICMP will hold with CSOs and families on the missing persons issue.

title.narrative: Output 2.2: Libya benefits from international, high throughput DNA testing capacities at the ICMP DNA Laboratory in The Hague
Number of consultation meetings held with Libyan authorities to assess their missing persons identification efforts

description.narrative: This is a new indicator that ICMP will report on beginning 1 October 2023. The consultation meetings will refer to forensic capacity building activities, specifically the assessments of the two DNA laboratories (in-person should conditions permit), and planned periodic discussions between ICMP and Libyan DNA experts.

comment.narrative: New indicator introduced from the following year

comment.narrative: ICMP does not foresee conducting visits to the MLD DNA laboratory in Baghdad for the remainder of 2023. Instead, ICMP prioritized re-engaging with MLD through online meetings to gauge interest in discussing DNA qualtity management matters.

Output 2.2: Missing persons data among Iraqi institutions are synchronized
Number of Iraqi institutions engaged to advance the importance of a central record of missing persons

comment.narrative: In November 2023, ICMP planned to deliver a data centralization workshop in Baghdad to MGD, MLD, YSD and the IHCHR. However, due to the worsening security situation owing to events happening in Gaza, ICMP had to prioritize staff duty of care and was unable to deploy an international expert to deliver the workshop. ICMP intends to carry out the workshop in 2024, security situation permitting.
